obs: mod-nims initialized — observing per NIMS doctrine (FEMA ICSSCI SM-0322); checklist mod-nims-checklist.md

Start Operation modal exposes only 4 fields (Op Name, Task Force Name, Multi-building checkbox, Assign Apparatus) — no NIMS Type I-V preset selector visible, so OP1 IC will land in default 9-role tree regardless of incident complexity (collapse is Type II)

No Unified Command toggle or multi-IC slot in Start Op modal — IC field is implicitly singular, so UC introduction at E+6:00 (Sheriff Garza joining) will require workaround or app surfaces no doctrinal way to seat two co-equal ICs

Default ICS role tree contains 9 roles (IC, Safety, Operations + 6 Ops sub-roles: Entry, Rescue, Initial Shoring, Runner, Cutting Table, Wood Shoring) — entire Planning, Logistics, Finance/Admin sections plus PIO, Liaison, and Branch tier are absent; participants must build them as custom roles for Type II structure

Default role 'operations' has 6 children (Entry, Rescue, Shoring, Runner, Cutting, Wood) — exactly span 6, sits inside FEMA 3-7 range but already one short of the 7-cap, so any added Group will surface the span warning on first custom role addition

commandView DOM node exists but is empty (childCount 0) and hidden — org chart is rendered on-demand only after operation start; no staging-area placeholder exists in the default tree (Staging reports to OSC per FEMA Fig 6-2)

38 apparatus pre-loaded but only 6 hold strut inventory at T-15 (Engine 1=6, Engine 3=4, Rescue 1=42, Rescue 2=26, Rescue 3=16, Squad 1=36, Tower 1=4, USAR-Alpha=52, USAR-Bravo=36, TF caches 338+444+444+444); apparatus typed via 7 default types (Chief/Engine/Ladder/Rescue/Squad/Task Force/Other) — no NIMS resource typing (Strike Team vs Task Force distinction not modeled)

Operations tab exposes 3 sub-views (Operations / Command / Cut Table) but no operational-period indicator in header — when OP1->OP2 boundary fires at E+4:00 there is no visual marker that the operational period changed; entire 36-hr op will read as one continuous timeline
